steps.name: Given I am on the login page
When I enter "saad@cartpanda.com" in email field
And I enter "Vista123+@" in password field
And I click on Signin button
Then I should see Select store Page
When I click on "msaad" button
Then I should see Dashboard Page
And I click on Admin btn in sidebar
Then I click on Shipping card in the settings
And I shouLd see the Shipping heading
When I click on Create shipping profile button
Then I enter "TestProfile(Country: Brazil)" in the Shipping profile name input box
Then I click on Add products button
And I select only one product from the list
And I click on Select Button
Then I click on Shipping Profile Save button
Then I click on Add Shipping zone Button
Then I enter "Test Zone" in the Shipping zone name input box
And I click on Edit Button
Then I enter "Brazil" in the Country input box
Then I click on Save changes button
Then I click on Add rate button
And I enter "Standard Shipping" in the Shipping rate name input box
Then I enter "5" in the Shipping rate amount input box
And I click on Save rate button
Then I click on Save button to create shipping profile
